method: Same Edge browser process, two paused pages, only the measured page foreground and rendering. Alternate before/after at each of six identical cameras. Standard quality 1600x1000 DPR1; five identical racers, water t12. compileAsync, 120 warmup +120 RAF samples. All values retained, no outlier removal; GPU timers only non-disjoint.
